The '''Huwawans''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="The Acolyte" /> [[Brother]]s [[Taibik Kajok]] and [[Wiltoo Kajok]] were members of this species.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Biology and appearance==
The Huwawans were a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin, black [[hair]], and large features. They spoke a language known as [[Huwawi]] with multiple dialects, and sometimes required a translation device to communicate with individuals who spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> at least two<ref name="The Acolyte" /> Huwawan<ref name="TAVG" /> [[brother]]s<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/cxkbqcn53nzbx6xsq3fwbrs|text=PDX-FF-001349|date=2024-06-24}}</ref>, [[Taibik Kajok|Taibik]] and [[Wiltoo Kajok]], operated a small makeshift landing port on the [[planet]] [[Khofar]], once leading visitors on expeditions into the nearby [[forest]]s and treacherous [[jungle]]s, though they had long since retired from that line of business.<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Big-Browed-Species-Manzella.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella]]
The Huwawans made their debut in the [[Day (episode)|fourth episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Alex García López]].<ref name="The Acolyte" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20190121223617}}</ref> Their name was revealed within the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''<ref name="TAVG" /> which released in select countries on [[June 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241710425-star-wars-the-acolyte-visual-guide|text=Star Wars The Acolyte Visual Guide}}</ref>
